turns.replyTail:
it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

If the order was placed before 12:30 PM, it is usually processed the same business day. If it was placed after 12:30 PM, it is usually processed the next business day. Orders placed on Friday afternoon or on holidays are shipped on the next business day.

The tracking number is normally sent once the order has been prepared and shipped 👍
